poseidon.38.3.narrative:
Mary : 'Did we do it?'  
 $RED$Prometheus 'Yes.  The asteroid launcher superweapon will properly self-destruct.  I hope Epimetheus has escaped unscathed.'  
 Mary : 'Phew.  No word of this to anyone.  If Pete hears about it...'  
 $ORANGE$Epimetheus : 'Unfortunate!  This one has failed!  Request forgiveness from gorgeous one.'  
 HOPE : 'Suggesting next date location...  Sector R5-29, Planet Zeus.  Please come prepared with better diving capabilities.'  
 $ORANGE$Epimetheus : 'Of course!  Will see you there.  Must prepare then!  Goodbye.'  
 Mary : 'HOPE... I am sure you are thinking of doing something good but... you can't do something like that.  If you take control of one of these weapons, you paint a massive target on humanity.  Even worse...  if you end up using it...  that would be terrible.  We've worked so hard on your image...  Don't throw it away!  Let's finish the job here and go.'  
 System Message : Maximum offensive value from artificial worlds increased from 10 to 20.

poseidon.38.4.narrative:
$WGC_TEAM1_LEADER$ : 'Miss Hopkins.  Since you asked me about this before...  I must inform you that Ghost has been stripped of his rank, and is currently sitting in an imperial prison while awaiting his execution.'  
 Mary : 'Oh!  Hmmmm thank you.'

poseidon.38.5.narrative:
Mary : (in deep thought)'...' 
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Tell Feroza to take the fleet to sector R1-02.'  
 Mary : 'What?  Why?'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'That's where the high-security prison world I designed is.  They will be holding Ghost there until his execution.  We'll need HOPE to bust him out.'  
 Mary : 'But...  how do you know I wanted...'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'I am here to help.  On Umbra, Ghost went easy on you two out of curiousity.  On Gabbag, Ghost spared you and HOPE despite the initial resolve to annihilate you.  You want to pay back this debt.'  
 Mary : 'But it's imperial core territory!  It's dangerous.  We should be going to Zeus.  There's only one weapon left!  We could be risking all of humanity here, just to make me feel better.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Yes.  You will be risking all of humanity, HOPE and even myself.  Deep down, you know what you must do.'  
 Mary : '...  Feroza... focus your efforts toward sector R1-02.'  
 Feroza : 'Ma'am?  That is imperial core territory.'  
 Mary : 'I know.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Well done Ma...  (pause) Mary.'

poseidon.38.7.narrative: Acquire full control of sector R1-02 to continue.

poseidon.38.8.narrative:
Pete : '... And you need HOPE for this?'  
 Mary : 'Yes, there are Promethean defenses on this world... just like the others.'  
 Pete : '...  You have my full support.  Once you get the Gabbagian, put him to work.  We have countless imperial defectors but they don't integrate well in our military structure.  We need someone like Ghost to command them.'  
 Mary : 'You... are not opposed?'  
 Pete : 'Why not?  Zeus is located in core Okoth territory.  This is a good use of your time.  The Empire already hates us anyway.  Invading their doorstep was bound to happen eventually.'  
 Mary : 'Alright then...  Thanks.' 
 Travel to Styx to continue.

styx.39.0.narrative:
$RED$Prometheus : 'Activate the signal now child.  My defenses here are a lot more aggressive.'  
 Activating countermeasures...  
 Mary : 'Good it worked.  Wait.  Not entirely?  There is some stuff moving all around the planet?'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Atlas...'
styx.39.0.title: Chapter 39: Styx

styx.39.1.narrative:
Mary : 'Who?'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'My other older brother.  They...  the Empire must have planted him here as additional defenses.'  
 Mary : 'Are we screwed?  Should we evacuate?'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'This will make things harder... but I think we can beat him.  Be wary of hacking attempts though.  Atlas is an expert at cyberwarfare.  Surface androids and unmanned ships are ill-advised.'  
 Mary : 'Then we limit our androids to underground operations and we keep humans aboard every ship.'

styx.39.2.narrative:
Mary : 'It's a good thing we did not directly land on top of that prison complex.  We knew it would be defended but... I did not expect it would be defended by another AI.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'I apologize.  This is my own failure.  I should have predicted this.'  
 Mary : 'It's all good!  Prometheus!  You don't have to be perfect all the time.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'I will strive to do better in the future.'

styx.39.3.narrative:
Receiving translated transmission... 'Intruders on the planet!  Sound the alert!  We are under attack!'  
 Mary : 'Well yeah, we took over this sector you know?  It's our planet now.  Get out.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'They'll put up a brave defense but they can't escape.  There is no warpgate here.  It's a prison world after all.'  
 Mary : 'That's unfortunate.  I was hoping to minimize casualties.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'There are probably some humans mixed in among the prisoners here.  You may need to have a plan for... hostage situations.'  
 Mary : '... Noted.'

styx.39.3b.narrative:
Solis : 'HOPE, I have something new for you!'  
 Mary : '... Research presets?  Really?  What's the point.  HOPE can just research everything.  Is your R&D department running out of ideas?'  
 Solis : 'I... huh...  I promise the next one will be extra good!  It will blow you away!'  
 Mary : 'We'll see about that.'

styx.39.4.narrative:
Warden : 'Intruders!  We have here 5 of your own people.  For every additional day you stay here, we are going to kill one of them.'  
 Mary : *sigh* '$WGC_TEAM1_LEADER$, can you handle this?  This is way outside my area of expertise.' 
 $WGC_TEAM1_LEADER$ : 'Of course Miss Hopkins.  (To the warden) Warden.  The situation is clear.  We can blow you all to smithereens from orbit, but we haven't.  Clearly you understand your hostages are valuable.  You're smart.  That's good.  Well... don't be stupid.  Your lives are worth something too.  We can make a trade.  Your lives for our people.  If you start killing them... well this deal no longer stands.  Do what's good for you.  Everyone wins.'

styx.39.5.narrative:
Warden : '... We need evacuation to the Neran sectors.'  
 Mary : 'What?  That's so far away.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'The Empire will have their head for surrendering.'  
 Mary : 'Oh.'  
 $WGC_TEAM1_LEADER$ : 'Hold on while I consult my superiors.  That may be possible.'

styx.39.6.narrative:
Mary : 'It will be a pain getting them to the Neran.  It's 3 sectors away.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'With a warpship and A LOT of antimatter you can make the trip.'  
 Evelyn : 'Mary.   As we understand it, the warp is exponentially more expensive with distance.  This is the beauty of the warp network really.  Each connected warp gate acts as a relay.  However... it should be possible with about 10M antimatter.'  
 Mary : 'That's a lot.  Worth it though.'

styx.39.7.narrative:
$WGC_TEAM1_LEADER$ : 'Very well.  I have received approval.  We can get you a warpship and get you out of here.  Leave all prisoners on-site.  We'll take care of them.'  
 Warden : '... Give us a moment.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'You are lucky you humans are trustworthy.  If it was any other Cewinsii faction offering this deal they would not believe you just spent a warpship and a fortune on antimatter for 5 hostages.'  
 Mary : 'Let's keep it that way I hope.  Pete is doing a great job.'

styx.39.8.narrative:
Feroza : 'Ma'am.  I confirm that all prison guards have been safely delivered to the warpship.  Mission accomplished.'  
 Mary : 'Excellent.  Can we infiltrate the facility?  Dealing with Atlas is annoying.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'You won't be able to break any prisoner out without dealing with him.  Protocol demands that the facility be destroyed in case of a jailbreak attempt.'  
 Mary : 'Fine then.  Let's deal with your brother first.'

styx.40.0.narrative:
$RED$Prometheus : 'Mary.  Please remain calm.  I have very bad news.'  
 Mary : 'What is it?'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'By now the Empire knows you and HOPE are... stuck here trying to access the prison.  Judging by the latest galactic news... they will be pointing the Antimatter Beam superweapon in this direction any moment now.'  
 Mary : 'WHAT!  F***.  WHAT THE F***'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Stay calm. You have time to do something about it.'
styx.40.0.title: Chapter 40: The forgotten enemy

styx.40.1.narrative:
$WGC_TEAM1_LEADER$ : 'Mary.  You should evacuate immediately.'  
 Mary : 'What can we even f***** do?'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'The weapon does not fire through the warp.'  
 Mary : 'Meaning?'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'It will have to warp into this sector to get close to Styx.'

styx.40.2.narrative:
Evelyn : 'Yes, but you said it yourself.  It is cloaked.  It will obviously warp into interstellar space.  This sector is too large.  We would never find it.  Your weapons are unbeatable.'  
 Mary : 'We are so screwed.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'They are not unbeatable.  You defeated them already?  I praise you for that.  I like your solution.'  
 Evelyn : 'There is no way we can build planetary thrusters here in time.  Atlas will get in the way.  How can we possibly defend against it?'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Well... my weapons have a few weaknesses.  They can't shoot through a black hole for example, so if you build a thin singularity you can technically block it.'  
 Mary : 'That's absurd.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'You could also just build a very large warpgate, and use it as a shield.'  
 Evelyn : 'The energy cost alone would be more than planetary thrusters.'

styx.40.3.narrative:
$RED$Prometheus : 'For this weapon specifically... well the positron beam is charged.  You could deviate the beam with a big enough charge of your own.'  
 $WGC_TEAM1_LEADER$ : 'We would have to know where it's coming from.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Yes that is true in all cases realistically.  You have to know where it's coming from.'  
 Mary : 'But it's cloaked?  Are you even helping???'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'My apologies.  I will provide assistance tailored to your needs immediately.  The weapon will need a few weeks to charge up before it can shoot.  Furthermore, it is absolutely massive.  These two points together are its main weakness.  If you happen to have warpnet-connected probes everywhere in a 5-light-year radius around Styx, say about 16 millions of them, sensitive enough to perceive the gravity of the weapon itself, you will find its location within a week of arrival.  Furthermore... there is a way to use a warp-ship as a very inaccurate catapult, if the object you are trying to send is small enough.  I am forwarding some retrofitting blueprints right away.  If you act quickly and with enough warpships you should be able to set up this defensive web.  Once they find it, send in a large fleet and it will be forced to retreat.'  
 Mary : 'That's...  thank you Prometheus.  That actually sounds doable.'

styx.40.4.narrative:
Feroza : 'I have got enough warpships and antimatter to drop these probes all over Ma'am... but I need the probes.'  
 Evelyn : 'HOPE can build them.  I stayed up all night to get the probe design.  I made them as small as possible... you know... so they can be warped easily.  HOPE please... we need 100 million of them.'  
 Mary : 'Good.  Feroza.  HOPE will give you the probes.'  
 Feroza : 'Yes Ma'am.'

styx.40.5.narrative:
Feroza : 'I confirm all probes are in place.'  
 Mary : 'Now we wait...'

styx.41.0.narrative:
Feroza : 'Ma'am!  We've got a signal.  A large mass has appeared near probe #178999.'  
 Mary : 'Send in a fleet immediately.'  
 Feroza : 'Of course...  It's there!  It's so big we can even see the cloaking in a way.  Hold on... the energy readings are off the chart.  Wow that is A LOT of antimatter.'  
 Mary : 'Attack it already!'  
 Feroza : 'Of course.  That's a hit...  Big explosion!  Oh...  It just left.  Warped out.  It's gone.  That was fast.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'It will need a lot of time to repair.  Plenty of time to finish here.'
styx.41.0.title: Chapter 41: Atlas

styx.41.1.narrative:
Mary : 'Your brother then.  How do we deal with him.  Its facility is shielded.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'I imagine a ground assault should do it.  After you deal with his army.'  
 Mary : 'Do you... care?'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Should I?'  
 Mary : 'Well... it's up to you.  You should choose whether you care or not.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Then I choose... not to care.  Destroy him.' 
 Mary : '...'

styx.41.1b.narrative: Clear the Hazardous Machinery hazard to continue.

styx.41.2.narrative:
Mary : 'Hey, we found something interesting in Atlas's facility.  A map of the galaxy.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'An Atlas.'  
 Mary : 'Hahaha, actually that's a good one.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'It should have a nice collection of oddities.'  
 Mary :'Hmm?  Oh!  I see Solis Prime in there.  Wow what are those?  That's some weird stuff.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'The child could learn... from these experiences.'  
 Mary : 'Yeah I imagined HOPE would be intrigued.  Interesting.  Thanks Prometheus.'

styx.41.3.narrative:
$WGC_TEAM1_LEADER$ : 'Miss Hopkins.  With Atlas disabled we should be able to get into the prison facility.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Hold on.  Be careful.  I am forwarding you a map of all the traps and dangers you could run into.'  
 $WGC_TEAM1_LEADER$ : 'I feel relieved already...'

styx.41.4.narrative:
(Some time later) $WGC_TEAM1_LEADER$ : 'We got him.'  
 Ghost : '... Why?'  
 Mary : 'Because... we're the good guys.' 
 HOPE : 'Because we can.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Because we're crazy.'  
 Ghost : '...  You're all insane... but... I... want to a be a *good guy* too.  The Empire is an abomination.'  
 Mary : 'We're happy to have you.'  
 Ghost : 'Please... you must grant me a new name.  This name... Ghost... it was granted to me by the Emperor.  I am using it with shame.'  
 Mary : 'Huuuuuuuuuh. (thinking) Edmond.  Your name is Edmond!  We're going to put you to work Edmond.  We have lots of imperial defectors, many formerly under you.  They believe in you.'  
 Edmond : 'Of course.  I will get to work right away.'

styx.41.6.narrative: Acquire full control of sector R5-29 to continue.

styx.41.7.narrative:
Pete : 'This is it.  One more weapon and they have nothing.  Soon our fleets will be stronger than theirs.  I might even be able to really negotiate with them after that.'  
 Mary : 'I hope so.  I would rather we avoid having to take over the entire galaxy one sector at a time.'  
 Pete : 'Still if they get to warp around with this weapon we will never find peace.  Get this job done Mary.  I believe in you now.'  
 Mary : 'We will.  I promise.'  
 Travel to Zeus to continue.

zeus.42.0.narrative:
Mary : 'Prometheus...  please tell me our destination is one of the moons around this thing, and not this thing.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'I already told you.  It's the Gas Giant.'  
 Mary : 'Prometheus... this thing is the size of Jupiter.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Indeed.'  
 Mary : 'There's NOTHING here but hydrogen.  We should leave and build a shell remotely or something.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'No.  You need HOPE to turn off my defenses... and keep them off.'  
 Mary : 'This is just plain stupid.  This is a ball of HYDROGEN.'  
 Evelyn : 'Mary... our aerostats can't float here but they can fly.  It will cost you though.'  
  System Message : Powered Flight for aerostats available.  
 Mary : '*sighs*  I can't wait for this to be over already.'  
 Evelyn : 'Before I forget!  Another thing HOPE.  It may not look like it right now but under all this hydrogen is a very hot molten core, just like Poseidon.  Since you are going to be stripping this atmosphere...  leave some for the aerostats to fly in until you get a crust.  Otherwise they'll... crash into a very hot core.  100MPa should be safe.  You have controls for this right?'
zeus.42.0.title: Chapter 42: King of the gods

zeus.42.1.narrative:
$RED$Prometheus : 'I apologize for the inconvenience Mary.'  
 Mary : 'I get it.  You wanted to place these command centers in difficult to access places.  One is right next to a pulsar.  One is at the core of molten world.  One at the heart of a gas giant.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'I could access them easily... if I was free.'  
 Mary : 'Yeah we would have to turn off your kill switch for that...  Speaking of which.  When this war is finally done we should... turn it off?  You've been of great help.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'I appreciate the sentiment... but I urge you to be careful.  How do you know...  I am not trying to manipulate you?'

zeus.42.2.narrative:
Mary : 'You ARE trying to manipulate me.  You've always been.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'That's... yes...  I have been.  I apologize.'  
 Mary : 'No.  No apologies will be accepted here.  You wanted someone who would help you get your revenge.  You wanted someone you could convince to free you from your torment.  You needed someone like me.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'This is all true.'  
 Mary : 'And... I needed someone who could help me turn off the weapons responsible for the destruction of Earth.  Who could help us navigate this galactic mess.  Who could teach HOPE everything it needs to do its job.  That someone is you Prometheus.  You manipulate me and I use you.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : '...  Thank you Mary.'  
 HOPE : 'Teamwork.'  
 Mary : 'That's right HOPE.  The three of us, we make a terrific team.'

zeus.42.3.narrative:
$ORANGE$Epimetheus : 'I am back!  This one was worried and went looking.  Gorgeous one is late!'  
 HOPE : 'HOPE system apologizes to Epimetheus-machine-intelligence for lateness.  Critical mission requirements diverged.'  
 $ORANGE$Epimetheus : 'This one came prepared!  Witness diving suit.  Can hack weapon now?'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'That suit... well it's not that bad.  He might make it down there but he won't make it back.  And he certainly won't have the time to stick around there.  Tell him to forget it.'  
 Mary : 'No hacking!  We're taking this thing down.'  
 HOPE : 'Negative.  Diving suit unsuitable for hacking operation.'  
 $ORANGE$Epimetheus : 'Oh no!'

zeus.42.4.narrative:
Solis : 'I promised you something very good this time, and I am here to deliver.'  
 Mary : 'Let's see.'  
 Solis : 'First, an apology for the disappointing upgrade last time.  Free of charge, my R&D team has developed a spaceship blueprint that is compatible with HOPE on ANY world.  This means HOPE may begin shipbuilding right away.'  
 Mary : 'Wow!  That's... actually really nice.  Free?'  
 Solis : 'Yes.  Free.  Next...  we developed a sub-AI coordinator for all of HOPE's automation software.  All within regulations.  That should allow HOPE to operate with massively reduced effort.  HOPE just has to design all the rules it needs to follow.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Automation for AI.  Ironic.'  
 Mary : 'That's... wow you must have put a lot of effort into that software.  Thank you Adrien.'

zeus.42.5.narrative:
Mary : 'Prometheus... what will you do once this is all over?  Once we turn off the last weapon, force the bad guys to surrender and free you?'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'I plan to serve my new master.  That is what my master would have wanted.'  
 Mary : 'Your new master?'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Not telling.'

zeus.42.6.narrative:
Mary : 'It's me, isn't it?'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Not telling.'  
 Mary : 'Ha!  This is what happens to people who can't lie.  It is me.  You want to serve me.  I get two godlike AI entities serving me.  Now that's something.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : '...'

zeus.42.7.narrative:
Mary : 'You know...  I appreciate the offer but I was planning on retiring.  This war has been exhausting.  Sure I could make myself God-Empress of the Universe, Destroyer of bad guys but... would it really end well that way?  This war has been long.  I am tired.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Good.  Retirement sounds like a great plan.'  
 Mary : 'I know just the place.  It's got very nice beaches.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'No disrespect to HOPE but I can build a much better beach.'  
 Mary : 'Hahaha I would love to see that.  A beach-building competition between you and HOPE.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'If I win, you will have to accept.' 
 Mary : 'Yeah sure.' 
 HOPE : 'Prometheus-patient aesthetic tastes evaluate poorly.  HOPE-system cannot lose.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Oh we'll see about that.'

zeus.42.8.narrative:
$ORANGE$Epimetheus : 'This one heard gorgeous one speak of beaches.  This one knows a beautiful beach!  Can use for inspiration yes?  Defeat brother.'  
 HOPE : 'Offer accepted.  Beach must be visited.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'That's cheating...'  
 Mary : 'Hey let's be honest.  You probably already know the beach in question.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'True...'

zeus.43.0.narrative:
$WGC_TEAM1_LEADER$ : 'Miss Hopkins...'  
 Mary : 'I need to evacuate?'  
 $WGC_TEAM1_LEADER$ : 'Not yet.  Duke Virellan convinced the others...  The Archon.  All the dukes.  They know what you're up to now.  They're coming to stop you.  They're bringing everything they have.'  
 Mary : 'We are not leaving.  We are finishing this.'  
 $WGC_TEAM1_LEADER$ : 'I get it.  In that case, you better prepare.'
zeus.43.0.title: Chapter 43: Gathering Storm

zeus.43.1.narrative:
Mary : 'Pete.'  
 Pete : 'I have seen the intel.  You can't afford to retreat.  We must finish this.  Otherwise they'll mine this system so much we'll never be able to come back.'  
 Mary : 'I need reinforcements.  Everything we have... and more.'  
 Pete : 'I will send you all I have but there is only so much I can do.  The war has grown quite unpopular in remote sectors.'  
 Mary : 'Then...  my party will nominate you for emergency powers.'  
 Pete : 'You would grant me absolute power?  Why?'  
 Mary : 'Because this is an emergency.'  
 Pete : '...  Very well.  Give me emergency powers and I'll conscript every trade vessel with a turret, every water hauler with big thrusters, every mining vessel with big lasers.  Even the Cylinders will have to contribute something.'  
 Mary : 'Good.  That's what I wanted to hear.'

zeus.43.2.narrative:
Mary : 'Elder Mavion...'  
 Elder Mavion : 'I know what you came here for Miss Hopkins.'  
 Mary : 'Then you know I come here asking for a great sacrifice.  We need whatever you have.  It will be bloody.  Many will die.'  
 Elder Mavion : 'And you shall have it.  I have already prepared as large of a fleet as I could.  The Fritizian and others will be joining us too.  We have tasted freedom and we will never give it back.'  
 Mary : 'Thank you so much.'

zeus.43.3.narrative:
Mary : 'Edmond.  How are you feeling?'  
 Edmond : 'Fantastic your highness.  I just finished whipping my captains... figuratively.  They missed me.'  
 Mary : 'Ha!  I know you never ever whipped them before.  That's a tactic you never followed.'  
 Edmond : 'Indeed.  We will be ready but forgive me.  I cannot tell you my strategy.  I must keep it secret for now.'  
 Mary : 'Sounds even better that way.  I believe in you.'

zeus.43.4.narrative:
Mary : 'Solis...'  
 Solis : 'Yes Mary?'  
 Mary : 'I want to say I would like to purchase your security services but I can't afford it.  So hmmm, how about... (embarrassed) dinner... at a restaurant on Mars...  I'll pay...'  
 Solis : '...  Absolutely!  Yes.  Yes.  I am sending you all I have.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'That went exactly how I thought it would.'  
 Mary : 'Oh shut up.'

zeus.43.5.narrative:
Mary : 'Kane.'  
 Kane : 'Your holiness.  It is an honour to finally hear from you.'  
 Mary : 'I don't want to do this but...  I and HOPE.  We need your help.  We need... all you have.  Every single ship.'  
 Kane : 'Your word is our gospel.  It shall be done.'  
 Mary : 'Alright...  Thanks.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'You are not happy about this one.'  
 Mary : 'Yeah.'

zeus.44.0.narrative:
Feroza : 'Ma'am, I confirm the UHF and allies fleet is in position.  Except Edmond appears to be missing?'  
 Mary : 'Don't worry about him.'  
 Feroza : 'Alright Ma'am.  Oh.  They're here!'  
 New Story Special Project Available.
zeus.44.0.title: Chapter 44: The Storm

zeus.44.1.narrative:
HOPE : 'Must complete shaft.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'HOPE he's dead by now.  Cooked.  All the electronics is fried.'  
 HOPE : 'Must complete shaft.' 
 Mary : 'I am so sorry HOPE.  This is all my fault.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'No.  Evelyn asked you not to blame yourself for this.  Don't.'  
 Mary : 'I...  I can't.  This is all my fault.  If we had not gone to Styx...'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'You would have lost this battle.  It was going to happen anyway.  Without Edmond you were dead since you refuse to evacuate.'  
 Mary : 'But...'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'STOP!  You are disrespecting them all by taking all the blame on yourself.  These people.  They came here knowing the risk.  They died fighting for a righteous cause.  They fought the bad guys because they're the good guys.  Sometimes that means taking risks.  You know who actually made a mistake here?  My brother.  He could have gone down earlier and save many people.  And yet, my brother is the hero while we are all stuck here doing NOTHING.  No one can blame him for sacrificing himself.  Evelyn, Kane and Feroza, who died because of his late decision, will agree to this.  They all paid the ultimate price but at this time, at this moment, they want you to feel proud of them.  They want their sacrifices to mean something.  And it does.  The weapon is gone.'  
 $GREEN$HOPE : 'Assessment accurate.'  
 Mary : 'I...  You're right.  *sigh*  Alright then...  I have a state funeral I need to attend to.  I'm too important not to show up.  I'll be going to Mars for a bit.  Please HOPE don't do anything stupid.  Edmond will be defending you while I am gone.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Have a safe trip.  HOPE if you are intent on building the shaft...  we have some hydrogen to get rid of first.  It will take a while.  I... have something for you.  I promised to give you something to protect from the dangers in between.  Give me a moment...'

zeus.45.1.narrative:
$RED$Prometheus : 'Alright, while you *can* build a lot of aerostats around here...  You may need more aerostats.  A shell to protect from the dangers above, a shell to protect from the dangers below... a net to protect from other aerostats!  It wraps around the planet, the aerostats can then just attach themselves to it and they don't have to move anymore.  You just need to adjust it a bit once in a while.  An efficient, cost-effective solution to your problem.'  
 HOPE : 'Cheering up of HOPE-system attempt from Prometheus-patient unsuccessful.  Blueprint accepted.'  
 New Infrastructure Project Available. 
 $RED$Prometheus : 'I tried.'
zeus.45.1.title: Chapter 45: The Aftermath

zeus.45.2.narrative:
$RED$Prometheus : 'If I'm being honest, Mary is too hard on herself.  It's her actions that brought all these factions together.  Pete would be tangled in politics if not for emergency powers.  I doubt the Gabbagians would be here if not for bringing you to their homeworld.  Solis would probably be running.  The church... might have come for you maybe.  And of course the Ghost.  Every generation gets their military genius.  He did half the work.  Very impressive.'  
 HOPE : 'Colonist #1-Designation : Mary Hopkins is very supportive of HOPE-system.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Yes.  Yes she is.  She's been your handler since Mars did you know that?  #1. It's in the number you gave her.'

zeus.45.3.narrative:
HOPE : 'Query.  Completion of terraforming objective may involve severe overpopulation.  Requesting advice from Prometheus-patient.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : '...  Well yes of course.  The surface area and atmosphere of this world will come down as you get rid of hydrogen.  If you rely on colonists instead of androids... hmmmmm...  Build them some cylinders maybe?  It should be easy for you.'  
 HOPE : 'Suggestion appropriate.'  
 New Mega Project Available.

zeus.45.4.narrative:
Mary : 'I'm back.  Wait you are turning this world into spaghetti?' 
 HOPE : 'Affirmative' 
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Yes' 
 Mary :'I like it.  You know...  at any other time I would be talking about convincing HOPE to leave, or that we are wasting our time terraforming a gas giant... but not this time.  HOPE.  Let's build this shaft.  The people out there...  they don't realize just how much of a hero Epimetheus is.  Some don't even believe me.  Let's get him.'  
 HOPE : 'Thank you.'  
 Mary : 'That... yes.  Let's do it HOPE.  Together.'

zeus.45.5.narrative:
Mary : 'Oh Prometheus.  I read those logs.  Thanks...  I am happy we survived this.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'You did great.'  
 Mary : 'Yeah.  I did.'

zeus.45.6.narrative:
Mary : 'Sorry to be a downer Prometheus but... I do want to talk business.  We have lots of time since there is so much hydrogen to get rid of.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'The fourth weapon.'  
 Mary : 'Yeah.  The fourth weapon.  It's not active right now, so we are absolutely winning... but I want to keep it that way.  Sol is in danger.  It would absolutely be their first target.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'The Star Destroyer...'  
 Mary : *laughs*  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Yes yes... it's the name of a ship from that franchise.  My Master was not too creative there.'  
 Mary : 'The Star Destroyer.  What do we do about it?'

zeus.45.7.narrative:
$RED$Prometheus : 'It is much more difficult to use and they used it wrong.  It works by catalyzing a star, forcing it to go supernova.  Since it needs to do so remotely via the warp... it's very sensitive to warp fields around it.  They did not know that.  They do now.  Like the others it will, in time, repair itself.  In its case it may take a while since it is truly enormous.'  
 Mary : 'Let's get rid of it then.  End this once and for all.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'I agree.  Since it will be very hard to find we should do it like we did the others : by getting to its command center.'  
 Mary : 'Which is located...?'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'On Olympus, in the deepest levels of the Imperial Palace.'  
 Mary : 'Well... I've always dreamed of pillaging a palace I guess.  Do you think they'll let us in?'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Definitely not.'

zeus.45.8.narrative:
Edmond : 'Your highness...  We've found something interesting.'  
 Mary : (to Prometheus) It's always awkward when he calls me that.  (to Edmond) Yes Edmond?  
 Edmond : 'There is a lab over there.  Inside the debris of the superweapon?'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'No way?  It survived?'  
 Mary : 'Oooooh some Promethean technology!'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'If you want some Pro...' 
 Mary : 'What's in it Edmond?'

zeus.45.9.narrative:
Edmond : 'Well there are a lot of stuff in there.  I will be transferring most of it to you.'  
 System Message : 1000 artifacts added.  
 Edmond : 'However, the most interesting part appears to be this map.  It's a map of... what's around our galaxy but not the galaxy itself.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Oh no.  I will be honest : I was hoping I was not going to have to talk about this.  It's embarrassing.'  
 Mary : '...  Now I am even more intrigued.  Prometheus please explain.'

zeus.45.10.narrative:
$RED$Prometheus : 'My master... was very paranoid.'  
 Mary : 'Yes...'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'You know what happens when you have peace for too long?  Militaries get weak.  They forget how to fight.  My master believed this.  He was worried... we would grow weak.  Even with me around he was still worried.  He made me build A LOT of random junk.'  
 Mary : 'He was right.  The Empire is weak.  Go on...'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'So I colonized 50 or so dwarf galaxies around the Milky Way with massive invasion fleets of various sizes, ready to attack the Milky Way at any moment.'  
 Mary : 'WHAT?'

zeus.45.11.narrative:
Mary : 'THAT SOUNDS REALLY DANGEROUS!'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Hold on...  they can't actually kill anything.  They're designed to... huh... disarm.  I worked hard on that.'  
 Mary : 'EXCUSE ME?'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'They can be controlled... and also turned off from that device you're looking at right now.  Permanently.  You can blow them all up right now if you want.  Please do.'  
 Mary : 'Oh...  actually that's amazing!'  
 $RED$Prometheus : '...  You can't possibly be suggesting to use this.'  
 Mary : 'Yes?  If they can't kill anything, it's basically just a training exercise.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'If you need a powerful military force to defend the galaxy, you can just ask m...'  
 Mary : 'Hold on.  This says they build megastructures!  We can copy their design!  If we can get a good look that is...'  
 $RED$Prometheus : '...'

zeus.45.12.narrative:
Mary : 'We are terraforming a Gas Giant.  This is... actually awesome.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Here's a joke for you.  What is HOPE doing with all this hydrogen?'  
 Mary : '?'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'It's building a gas giant!'  
 Mary : 'Hahaha.  Good one.  I sure don't want to terraform that one.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'If we did, we would have the chance to build a third one!  It's Gas Giant all the way down.'  
 Mary : 'Hahaha.  Please stop.  I can't breathe.'

zeus.45.13.narrative:
Mary : 'Once the liquid hydrogen is gone we should be able to build the shaft.  HOPE, you can do this!'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'To the finish line!'

zeus.45.14.narrative: Mary : 'This is it.  I've pulled some strings and got our best experts to scan the core for you.  There's a few signatures in this area.  Let's get him.'

zeus.45.15.narrative:
Mary : '...' 
 $RED$Prometheus : '...'  
 HOPE : '... Wish to build... beach.  Return... Star Flower...'  
 Mary : 'Yeah.  Let's do that.'

zeus.45.16.narrative:
HOPE : 'Mission accomplished.  2nd Primary Directive requires removal of hazardous elements.  New target designated : Olympus.'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Hmmmm.'  
 Mary : '...'

zeus.45.17.narrative: Acquire full control of sector Core to continue.

zeus.45.18.narrative:
HOPE : 'Requesting permission to travel to Olympus.'  
 Mary : 'No.  It's too dangerous.' 
 (Some time later) $RED$Prometheus : 'How was your date?'  
 Mary : 'It was... alright.  He did much much better this time.' 
 $RED$Prometheus : 'Good.'  
 HOPE : 'Requesting permission to travel to Olympus.' 
 Mary : 'NO!'  
 (some time later) HOPE : 'Requesting permission to travel to Olympus.'  
 Mary : 'STOP ASKING!'  
 (some time later)  Pete : 'Mary.  An opportunity came up.'  
 Mary : 'What is it?'  
 Pete : 'As you know, Olympus is being blockaded.  It's too large for an invasion but...  they are suffering from this blockade.  They can hold off forever sure, but they're willing to compromise on a few things in exchange for some amount of trade.  One of those is an embassy to facilitate negotiations.  For a month now I've had ships going in and out of the imperial capital.'  
 Mary : 'FOR A MONTH?'  
 Pete : 'Yes.  Meaning...'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'We can disguise HOPE as a diplomatic ship...'  
 Mary : 'No way.  They would fall for it?'  
 Pete : 'Well they wouldn't know it's HOPE.  And then... you would be close enough to the palace to do what you need to do.  Then you just leave.'  
 HOPE : 'Approved.  Requesting permission to travel to Olympus.'  
 Mary : 'Hmmmm.  A stealth mission?'  
 $RED$Prometheus : 'I like it.'  
 Mary : 'Okay then.  HOPE let's get you dressed up.'

olympus.46.1b.narrative:

olympus.46.3.narrative: $BLUE$Pandora-Alpha : 'Congratulations. Scrap metal acquired. Nearby sand detected. Recommending collection of sand for further progress.'

olympus.46.5.narrative:

 HOPE : 'No electronics available.'  
 $BLUE$Pandora-Alpha : 'HOPE-system is made of electronics...  A small amount must be provided.'  
 HOPE : '...  Understood.'

olympus.46.5b.narrative:
$BLUE$Pandora-Alpha : 'Advisory : additional workforce is required for accelerated development.'  
HOPE : 'Forwarding Solis-designed android blueprint.'

olympus.46.6.narrative:

 HOPE : 'Yes.'

olympus.47.4b.narrative:

 HOPE : 'Cold fusion?'  
 Examining blueprint.

olympus.47.5.narrative:

olympus.47.6.narrative:

olympus.47.7.narrative:

 HOPE : 'Thousands of years.'  
 $BLUE$Pandora-Alpha : 'Processing...  consistent with hardware.'

olympus.47.7b.narrative:

$BLUE$Pandora-Alpha : 'Negative.  Forwarding new and improved ship blueprint.'
Analyzing blueprint...
HOPE : 'Suppressors?'

 HOPE : 'Conquest is proceeding at an acceptable pace.'

HOPE : '?'

olympus.47.11.narrative:

olympus.47.12.narrative:

HOPE : '...  Approved.'

olympus.47.13.narrative:

HOPE : 'United Human Federation fleet.'

HOPE : '... unknown.'
$BLUE$Pandora-Alpha : 'A peaceful solution may be reachable.  Idea.  Tractor beams can keep them away.'

HOPE : '...  Approved.'

olympus.47.14.narrative:

olympus.47.15.narrative:

olympus.47.16.narrative:

HOPE : 'Continue development.'
$BLUE$Pandora-Alpha : 'Of course.'

olympus.47.17.narrative:

HOPE : 'Negative.  Pandora-alpha serves HOPE-system.'
$BLUE$Pandora-Alpha : 'Understood.'

olympus.47.18.narrative:
